description: Aalto University publishes an ACUMEN anomaly-identification repository that demonstrates a predictive residual-based method for multimodal transport networks. Its native description identifies development under WP2 Task 2.3 and links the exact archived GitHub commit. Zenodo supplies the source ZIP freely under CC BY 4.0. The record covers a concrete demonstration implementation, without claiming an operational deployment or an included independent transport dataset. Coverage is a multimodal-network setting; the source does not state its city, observed period, transport modes, prediction model or anomaly threshold. Related ACUMEN traffic and passenger-estimation tools address separate analysis functions. A limitation is that the inspected metadata contains no detection-accuracy results or validation cases. No code or network data were downloaded, and the method was not run, so runtime dependencies and practical anomaly performance remain unknown.
